📝 Walkthrough ## Walkthrough The PR adds repository-wide import conventions via new Cursor rules, enforces import deduplication through ESLint configuration, and consolidates scattered import statements across the UI library to align with the established patterns (grouping related imports, preferring relative paths for internal code, eliminating duplicates). ## Changes |Cohort / File(s)|Summary| |---|---| |**Cursor Rules Documentation**
`.cursor/rules/code-style.mdc`, `.cursor/rules/imports.mdc`|Added new import convention rules specifying grouping order (React, packages, relative paths), mandating relative imports for `libs/ui-lib` internals, and preferring local barrels over long paths. Updated code-style rules to reference the new imports guidance.| |**ESLint Configuration**
`libs/ui-lib/.eslintrc.cjs`|Enforced `no-duplicate-imports` as an error in the lib override to support new import deduplication standards.| |**CIM Components Import Consolidation**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/cim/components/ClusterDeployment/.../ClusterDeploymentHostsSelectionAdvanced.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/cim/components/ClusterDeployment/review/ClusterDeploymentReviewStep.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/cim/components/InfraEnv/InfraEnvAgentTable.tsx`|Consolidated multiple imports from the same source modules into single import statements (e.g., `AgentTableActions`, `wizardStepsValidationsMap`, `DropdownItem`).| |**Common Components Import Consolidation**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/clusterConfiguration/utils.ts`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/clusterWizard/ClusterWizardStepValidationsAlert.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/clusterWizard/networkingSteps/StackTypeControlGroup.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/clusterWizard/networkingSteps/SubnetsDropdown.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/hosts/HostStatus.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/ui/formik/types.ts`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/common/components/ui/uiState/EmptyState.tsx`|Consolidated duplicate/separate imports into combined import blocks; updated `EmptyState.tsx` to use `React.ComponentType` instead of standalone `ComponentType` import.| |**OCM Components & Store Import Consolidation**
`libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/components/clusterConfiguration/DiscoveryImageTypeDropdown.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/components/clusterWizard/ClusterDetails.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/components/clusters/ClustersListToolbar.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/components/ui/Buttons/BackButton.tsx`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/store/hooks.ts`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/store/slices/current-cluster/slice.ts`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/store/slices/current-user/slice.ts`, `libs/ui-lib/lib/ocm/store/slices/feature-flags/slice.ts`|Consolidated separate/type-only imports into single import statements; added `disconnected-iso` discovery image type with description.| ## Estimated code review effort 🎯 2 (Simple) | ⏱️ ~12 minutes ## Possibly related PRs - openshift-assisted/assisted-installer-ui#3515 — Complements this PR by adding cursor code-style and translation rules that work alongside the new import conventions. - openshift-assisted/assisted-installer-ui#3151 — Related through overlapping import consolidation changes in shared files like `ClusterDeploymentReviewStep.tsx` and `ClusterDeploymentHostsSelectionAdvanced.tsx`. - openshift-assisted/assisted-installer-ui#3346 — Modifies the same UI library files with similar import reorganization patterns, particularly in `ClusterDeploymentReviewStep.tsx`. ## Suggested labels `lgtm`, `approved`, `size/M` ## Suggested reviewers - jkilzi - asmasarw ## Poem > 🐰 *Hops through imports with glee and grace,* > *Consolidating clutter, finding their place,* > *No dupes allowed in this rabbit's domain,* > *Cleaner code flows through every refrain!* > *TypeScript and Eslint—a powerful pair,* > *Organization's magic is floating in air!* ✨
